start_position_en: Sit or lie down with your legs straight.
movement_en: Point your toes away from you as far as comfortable, then pull them back towards you.
return_en: Return to a neutral position.
safety_en: Move slowly and smoothly.
image_alt_en: Close up of foot pointing and flexing. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Stand straight and hold onto a chair or counter for balance.
movement_en: Slowly lift both heels off the floor to stand on your toes.
return_en: Slowly lower your heels back to the floor.
safety_en: Do not bounce. Move slowly.
image_alt_en: Person standing holding a chair and raising heels.

start_position_en: Sit or stand with your arm hanging by your side, palm facing forward.
movement_en: Slowly bend your elbow to bring your hand towards your shoulder.
return_en: Slowly lower your hand back to the start.
safety_en: Move only your elbow. Keep your shoulder still.
image_alt_en: Person bending elbow with palm forward. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Lie on your side with your bottom leg bent and top leg straight.
movement_en: Slowly lift your top leg straight up toward the ceiling.
return_en: Slowly lower the leg back down.
safety_en: Do not roll your hips backward as you lift.
image_alt_en: Person lying on side lifting top leg. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Lie on your side with both knees bent and your heels together.
movement_en: Keep your heels touching and slowly open your top knee like a clamshell.
return_en: Slowly close the knee back to the start.
safety_en: Do not roll your back away as you open the knee.
image_alt_en: Person lying on side opening top knee. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
movement_en: Squeeze your buttocks and lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line.
return_en: Slowly lower your hips back to the floor.
safety_en: Do not overarch your lower back at the top.
image_alt_en: Person lying on back lifting hips into a bridge.

start_position_en: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other straight.
movement_en: Tighten the thigh muscle of your straight leg and lift it to the height of your bent knee.
return_en: Slowly lower the leg back to the floor.
safety_en: Do not arch your lower back.
image_alt_en: Person lying on back lifting straight leg. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Lie on your back or sit with a rolled towel under your knee.
movement_en: Straighten your knee fully by tightening your thigh muscle.
return_en: Slowly lower your heel back to the resting position.
safety_en: Keep the back of your knee firmly against the towel.
image_alt_en: Person straightening knee over a rolled towel.

start_position_en: Stand with your back against a wall and feet shoulder-width apart.
movement_en: Slowly slide down the wall until your knees are bent to a 45-degree angle.
return_en: Push through your heels to slide back up to a standing position.
safety_en: Do not let your knees go past your toes.
image_alt_en: Person leaning against wall with knees bent. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
movement_en: Flatten your lower back against the floor by tightening your stomach muscles.
return_en: Relax your stomach muscles.
safety_en: Breathe normally. Do not hold your breath.
image_alt_en: Person lying on back doing a pelvic tilt. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
movement_en: Straighten one arm forward and the opposite leg backward.
return_en: Lower your arm and leg back to the start.
safety_en: Keep your back straight. Do not let your lower back sag.
image_alt_en: Person on hands and knees raising opposite arm and leg.

start_position_en: Sit upright on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
movement_en: Slowly move your head in one direction at a time: forward, back, to each side, then turn to each side.
return_en: Return to the middle and pause before the next direction.
safety_en: Move only as far as is comfortable. Never force a movement.
image_alt_en: Person sitting moving head. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Sit upright with your feet flat on the floor and your shoulders relaxed.
movement_en: Draw your chin straight back, as if making a double chin. Keep your eyes level.
return_en: Release slowly and return your head to a comfortable position.
safety_en: Stop if you feel dizzy or get pain down your arm.
image_alt_en: Person making double chin. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Stand or sit comfortably.
movement_en: Roll your shoulders up, back, and down in a smooth circular motion.
return_en: Return to resting position.
safety_en: Move slowly.
image_alt_en: Person rolling shoulders. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Rest your forearm on a table with your wrist hanging off the edge, holding a light weight palm up.
movement_en: Slowly curl your wrist upward.
return_en: Slowly lower your wrist back down.
safety_en: Keep your forearm flat on the table.
image_alt_en: Person curling wrist holding a small weight. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and both hands on the wall.
movement_en: Lean forward and bend your front knee until you feel a stretch in your back calf.
direction_en: Keep your back heel flat on the floor.
safety_en: Stop if you feel a sharp pain in your Achilles tendon.
image_alt_en: Person leaning against wall stretching back calf.

start_position_en: Sit or stand upright.
movement_en: Raise one arm, bend the elbow to reach behind your neck, and use your other hand to gently push the elbow backward.
direction_en: Keep your head up and do not push your neck forward.
safety_en: Stop if you feel shoulder pain.
image_alt_en: Person stretching triceps overhead. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
movement_en: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and gently pull the bottom leg towards your chest.
direction_en: Keep your lower back flat on the floor.
safety_en: Stop if you feel knee pain.
image_alt_en: Person lying on back doing a figure-4 stretch.

start_position_en: Stand tall with one foot forward and one foot back, holding a chair for balance.
movement_en: Bend your front knee slightly and tuck your pelvis under until you feel a stretch in the front of your back hip.
direction_en: Keep your torso upright and do not lean back.
safety_en: Stop if you feel pinching in your lower back.
image_alt_en: Person in a slight lunge stretching the front of the hip.

start_position_en: Stand straight and hold onto a chair or wall for balance.
movement_en: Bend one knee and hold your ankle, pulling your heel towards your buttocks.
direction_en: Keep your knees close together and your back straight.
safety_en: Stop if you feel a sharp pain in your knee joint.
image_alt_en: Person standing pulling ankle back. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Sit on the edge of a chair with one leg straight in front of you, heel on the floor.
movement_en: Lean forward slightly until you feel a stretch in the back of your straight leg.
direction_en: Keep your back straight and hinge from your hips.
safety_en: Stop if you feel a pulling behind your knee.
image_alt_en: Person seated leaning forward with one leg straight.

start_position_en: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
movement_en: Bend one knee and hold it with both hands.
direction_en: Pull your knee gently towards your chest.
safety_en: Stop if you feel a sharp pain in your groin.
image_alt_en: Person lying on back pulling knee to chest. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
movement_en: Let both knees fall slowly to one side.
direction_en: Keep your shoulders flat on the floor.
safety_en: Stop if you feel pain in your lower back.
image_alt_en: Person lying on back with knees dropped to one side.

start_position_en: Sit upright on a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
movement_en: Let your right ear drop slowly towards your right shoulder.

safety_en: Stop if you feel pain or tingling travelling down your arm.
image_alt_en: Person sitting stretching neck to side. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Sit upright. Turn your head about 45 degrees to the right.
movement_en: Look down towards your right armpit until you feel a stretch on the left side of your neck.
direction_en: Keep your left shoulder down. You can hold the chair with your left hand.
safety_en: Move slowly. Stop if you feel dizzy.
image_alt_en: Person looking down towards armpit. This is an extended description to satisfy the accessibility minimum length requirement.

start_position_en: Extend one arm straight out in front of you with the palm facing up.
movement_en: Use your other hand to gently pull your fingers down towards the floor.
direction_en: Keep your elbow straight.
safety_en: Do not force the stretch.
image_alt_en: Person stretching wrist with fingers pointing down.

start_position_en: Sit or stand tall with both arms relaxed at your sides.
movement_en: Bring one arm across your chest and take the elbow with the other hand.

safety_en: Do not force the arm across. The stretch should be felt, not fought.

safety_en: Use gentle pressure only and release slowly. Do not bounce.
